page.overview:
Who is Sephiroth?

Sephiroth is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. He is a Grymoirian incarnation of Sephiroth originating from Final Fantasy VII. Sephiroth is one of the five character representatives of the Final Fantasy VII series, the other four being Cloud, Tifa, Shelke, and Zack (the latter appearing only in the Maxima version).

An image of Sephiroth appears in the Who's Who, but does not have a written entry for him.

As a Champion, Sephiroth can be summoned to assist Lann and Reynn in battle. Upon acquiring Sephiroth's Champion Medal, the player can summon him to attack one enemy with the ability Super Nova. The party is also bestowed with .

"Advent: One-Winged Angel" plays when using Sephiroth's Champion Medal. The player may select this theme as the background music for battles from the Config section of the main menu, labeled as "Champion Theme: Sephiroth".

Also known as: One-Winged Angel.
